digest.component_or_area: Backend port and Jira family adapter integration
propositions: RemoteRef is never constructed in production code; only the test double backend_support.FakeBackend implements remote_ref() while the Backend protocol does not declare it

instance field of RemoteRef must be derived from normalized base URL at constructor time, not resolved at call time, to avoid breaking contract tests and violating protocol runtime-checkability constraints
instance field does not prevent local-id collision between two same-vendor deployments because _jira_key_to_local_id derives the id from Jira key alone, not from instance
vendor field already separates Cloud and DataCenter (jira vs jira-datacenter), so instance exists to disambiguate multiple deployments of the same vendor, not Cloud vs DC

both real backends must declare and implement remote_ref() port member receiving instance as injected constructor parameter from build_backend factories, and contract tests must verify they return non-empty instance only when explicitly passed
